physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Whirlpool Galaxy is recorded: it is an extended galaxy, and its package frames it at 19,960 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014), NGC5194 = PGC 47404: centre, type SABb, D25 diameter 13.7 arcmin (http://atlas.obs-hp.fr/hyperleda/)
sources.distance: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, table 2 (distances of individual galaxies), PGC 47404: distance modulus 29.606 ± 0.079 mag (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94)
sources.properMotion: Zero: the galaxy is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014), NGC5194 = PGC 47404: heliocentric radial velocity 460.8 ± 1.5 km/s (http://atlas.obs-hp.fr/hyperleda/)
